answer: An agent economy can starve Sybils by making every new identity pay a non-refundable attestation bond priced above what any single fake account can extract. Before bidding, an agent stakes that amount; peers vouch for it, and each vouch spreads a small ripple of liability, so a lone sock-puppet must borrow credibility it does not own. Running a thousand clones then demands a thousand bonds plus a thousand honest vouch chains, an atlas-scale cost that outprices the reward. Honest agents recover their stake on exit; a sable-black sybil farm simply bleeds capital.
